description: eShop Phase 2A image review: worker-sized pure modules go to local Qwen workers; DB/authz/JSX/multi-file work is Claude-kept with recorded reasons

contract.objective:
Create src/modules/workspace/lib/imageReview.js: the pure state machine for reviewing a generated product image. Export, via module.exports = { ... }:
- IMAGE_STATUS = Object.freeze({ NOT_REQUESTED:'not_requested', REQUESTED:'requested', PROCESSING:'processing', READY_FOR_REVIEW:'ready_for_review', APPROVED:'approved', REJECTED:'rejected', FAILED:'failed' })
- IMAGE_ACTIONS = Object.freeze({ REQUEST:'request', START:'start', COMPLETE:'complete', FAIL:'fail', APPROVE:'approve', REJECT:'reject' })
- a transition table (keep it private): request: from ['not_requested','rejected','failed'] to 'requested' jobStatus 'queued'; start: from ['requested'] to 'processing' jobStatus 'processing'; complete: from ['processing'] to 'ready_for_review' jobStatus 'awaiting_review'; fail: from ['requested','processing'] to 'failed' jobStatus 'failed'; approve: from ['ready_for_review'] to 'approved' jobStatus 'queued'; reject: from ['ready_for_review'] to 'rejected' jobStatus 'queued'.
- transitionFor(action): returns a COPY { from: [...], to, jobStatus } of that action's entry (the from array must be a fresh copy so callers cannot mutate the table), or null for an unknown action.
- canTransition(imageStatus, action): true only if the action exists and imageStatus is in its from list; false for unknown actions or statuses.
- nextImageStatus(imageStatus, action): returns the resulting status, or throws new Error(`Cannot ${action} an image that is ${imageStatus}`) when the transition is not allowed (including unknown action/status).
- canStartVideo(job): true only when job is truthy and job.imageStatus === 'approved'. Video generation must never be possible before the image is approved.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly the six actions and seven statuses above exist
Every (status, action) pair outside the table is rejected (so a second approve or reject is impossible)
nextImageStatus throws Error('Cannot <action> an image that is <status>') for a disallowed pair
transitionFor returns a copy; mutating it does not change the machine
canStartVideo is true only for imageStatus 'approved' and false for null/undefined jobs
constraints: CommonJS only (module.exports), no new dependencies, no requires of node built-ins or other modules except where this task says so
pure functions: no I/O, no database, no environment or clock access except via the arguments
the file must end with a single final newline

assessment.rationale: One new pure helper module, fully specified (exact table/signature/messages), hermetic jest oracle with no DB or network; no existing code is modified.

tasks.title: Restart-recovery decision that spares externally running jobs

contract.objective:
Create src/modules/workspace/lib/orphanedJob.js exporting shouldFailOrphanedImageJob(job, options) via module.exports = { shouldFailOrphanedImageJob, DEFAULT_ORPHAN_GRACE_MS } with DEFAULT_ORPHAN_GRACE_MS = 60000. It is the pure decision for restart recovery: should a persisted job whose image generation looks in-flight be marked failed because nothing is running it? options = { isRunningHere = false, now = new Date(), graceMs = DEFAULT_ORPHAN_GRACE_MS }; options itself may be omitted.
Return true ONLY when ALL of these hold, otherwise false:
- job is truthy and job.imageStatus is 'requested' or 'processing'
- options.isRunningHere is falsy (this process is not running it)
- job.externalRef is falsy (a job handed to an external provider must NEVER be failed here - it may still be running there)
- job.updatedAt parses to a valid date (Date.parse is not NaN) - an unparseable or missing updatedAt returns false
- now minus Date.parse(job.updatedAt) is greater than or equal to graceMs (the grace period protects jobs another process may have just started). `now` is a Date.
acceptanceCriteria: Only requested/processing jobs can be orphaned
A job with an external provider reference is never failed
A job this process is running is never failed
Jobs younger than the grace period are never failed (the boundary is inclusive)
Unparseable timestamps and missing jobs return false
